open_points.subject: rules.http_router_backend route count after challenge removal
open_points.text: 40_flows.md says “the route table keeps 50 of the 56 routes of rules.http_router_backend”, while 02_rules.md says “rules.http_router_backend (56 routes …)”
open_points.question: Does rules.http_router_backend now contain 50 routes, or does it still contain 56 routes with six challenge routes represented some other way?
options: The backend catalog contains exactly 50 routes after deleting the six challenge routes.
The backend catalog still contains 56 routes despite the State 4 status statement.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the removal as changing the backend catalog to exactly 50 routes.

witness.initial: The accepted texts are used to construct the State 5 route catalog after staff email challenges have been removed.
events: One implementer follows the changed State 4 status and materializes 50 routes.
Another implementer follows State 2’s carried backend declaration and materializes or validates 56 routes.
outcomes: The generated router and its closure contain exactly 50 routes and no challenge entries.
The generated router or its closure is required to contain 56 route entries.
witness.observer: A route-catalog closure check or API conformance test sees the differing route count.
